result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon, leaving blank space above the 'Orders' label while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' all display icons.
issues.suggestion: Add the appropriate icon above the 'Orders' label in the bottom navigation bar so it matches the styling and layout of the other navigation items.
